run_manual_control: run the manual control script to interact with a gym-minigrid environment using keyboard controls
run_with_custom_env: run the manual control script with a custom gym environment name via the --env argument
run_with_agent_view: run the manual control script with the --agent_view flag to render the agent's partial observable view
review_key_handler: review the key_handler function that maps keyboard keys to environment actions like left, right, forward, toggle, pickup, drop, and done
review_reset_function: review the reset function that seeds the environment, calls env.reset, and prints the mission string
